question: what is the size of their dataset?

evidence: The distribution of category labels on the remaining 87% is shown in Table TABREF10 . 14,074 (52%) questions could be answered. Out of the answerable questions, 10,160 could be answered from the text directly (text-based) and 3,914 questions required the use of commonsense knowledge (script-based). After removing 135 questions during the validation, the final dataset comprises 13,939 questions, 3,827 of which require commonsense knowledge (i.e. 27.4%). This ratio was manually verified based on a random sample of questions.

title: MCScript: A Novel Dataset for Assessing Machine Comprehension Using Script Knowledge
answer_rationale: Text 9 (page=7, section=Data Statistics) states: 'After removing 135 questions during the validation, the final dataset comprises 13,939 questions'. This directly provides the size of the final dataset.
